name: code-switched Hindi/English, rent spoken in mixed units

turns.text: Hello — I'm an AI assistant calling for a tenant about your listing in Andheri East. This will take under a minute, and I am recording it so she can hear your answers. Is that alright?
Theek hai. Flat dekhne kab aa sakte hain?
Kal shaam ko aa jao, chaar baje ke baad. Flat khaali hai abhi.
Rent aur deposit kitna hai abhi?
Rent pachattar hazaar, deposit do mahine ka. Society charges alag se.
Pachattar hazaar rent, do mahine deposit — sahi hai?
Nahi, yeh Jain building hai, non-veg bilkul allowed nahi hai.
Owner bachelors ko dete hain, ya sirf family?
Sirf family. Bachelors ko owner nahi dega.
Bas itna hi, dhanyavaad. Woh aapko seedha call karengi.
